data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Atthia was the name of a nymph who presided over Attica, a region in ancient Greece. The name may be derived from the Greek word 'attos', meaning 'self-governing'. The name Atthia carries the meaning “Nymph of Attica” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Atthia usually hope their child will grow to embody nymph of attica and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atthia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
